coordination_summary:
Six agent sessions have worked in this repository on 2026-10-22. arena/b4413b13-gold4 (PR #1, #3), arena/93da71b4-gold4 (PR #2) and arena/9614479d-gold4 (PR #4, #5) built the dataset, the site and the audit; arena/22b5b06c-gold4's review is preserved unmerged at docs/legacy/. Two sessions then re-verified the published tree line by line instead of trusting it: arena/fd51d093-gold4 (PR #7, Pass 4) and arena/e04b126a-gold4 (PR #10 and PR #13, Passes 5 and 6). The two passes were merged rather than stacked — where they disagreed, both readings are recorded and the disagreement is published on the Flagged page. Nothing from any other branch was deleted, renamed or force-pushed.
 Session arena/22b5b06c-gold4 later returned with its own independently collected dataset (15 Blue Nile / James Allen-line rows and 4 Brilliant Earth rows, 9 of them from live page fetches) plus a live gold-api.com spot reading; its integration merged main's published 35-row tree unchanged and added its rows to the same schema (PR #11), preserving its working files under data/preserved/, docs/legacy/ and scripts/session_22b5b06c/.

passes.pass: Pass 2 — dataset assembly + first integrity audit

Phantom-math check: no derived value may exist for a row without a published weight
Blank-value checks: blank price requires PRICE_UNVERIFIED, blank weight requires NO_WEIGHT_PUBLISHED or WEIGHT_UNVERIFIED
Domain allow-list: every source URL must belong to the named retailer or a government/benchmark host
Banned-domain scan: no marketplace, resale, blog or social domain anywhere in the data
Speculation-language scan on all free-text fields

Both readings are 2026-10-22 and they are not the same promise; the row keeps both and asks the buyer to confirm in writing.
